    • GetWeeklyTaskMatchingId

      public WeeklyTask GetWeeklyTaskMatchingId(String email, int taskId, LocalDate weekStart) throws Exception
      Gets a Weekly Task for a given taskId, email and weekStart
      Parameters:
      email - The email of the acccount you want to get the WeeklyTask from
      taskId - The taskId of the WeeklyTask you want
      weekStart - The weekStart of when the task occured
      Returns:
      The Weekly Task object with the accountEmail, taskId, status, reflection and weekStart
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - When weekStart, email or taskId is null or Empty
      SQLException - From a Database Access Failure
      Exception - If a "Bad" Weekly Task is made

    • GetTaskIdsAssignedForWeek

      public int[] GetTaskIdsAssignedForWeek(String email, LocalDate weekStart) throws Exception
      Gets all the taskId's for the WeeklyTasks assigned this week
      Parameters:
      email - The email of the account you want to get the taskId's for
      weekStart - The weekStart of the tasks you want to get
      Returns:
      A populated Array of the TaskId's for this week
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - If Week start or Email is null or empty
      SQLException - Database Access Failure
      Exception

    • InsertTasks

      public void InsertTasks(String email, LocalDate weekStart) throws Exception
      Inserts this week's weekly practices for the given email. These are chosen from the weekly-task pool, not from the labour's storyline quest tasks.
      Parameters:
      email - The email of the account you want to insert tasks for
      weekStart - The weekStart you want to insertTasks for
      Throws:
      Exception - For Database Update Failures and if week start or email is null or empty
